### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Route tokens to their k highest-scoring experts using top-k gating with normalized softmax routing coefficients.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l04_topk_moe_router(logits: list, k: int = 2) -> dict:
    arr = np.array(logits, dtype=float)
    idx = np.argsort(-arr, axis=-1)[..., :k]
    vals = np.take_along_axis(arr, idx, axis=-1)
    exp_v = np.exp(vals - np.max(vals, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    w = exp_v / np.sum(exp_v, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return {'indices': idx.tolist(), 'weights': np.round(w, 6).tolist()}
```
